models.name: ConvNeXt-T IN-1k · robust fold ensemble (upgrade default)
models.description: Chosen by cross-validation: Highest pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 among candidates (single recipes with/without 8-view TTA, and probability ensembles of 2-3 recipes) whose estimated CPU time for the whole fold ensemble is <= 1000 ms per photo; ties within 0.001 go to higher out-of-fold accuracy, then lower latency. Decided on out-of-fold data only; the test set is scored once afterwards.

operating_point.rule: lowest calibrated confidence with out-of-fold accuracy on answered photos >= 95% (coverage >= 50%)

ood.method: maha feature distance (fold models' own training photos)
